archive_policy: Saved 3.0 assessments replay the unchanged 3.0 evaluator. New cards carry an explicit methodology version.
growth: Observed unique study families in two completed three-year periods: (R+1)/(B+1). Incomplete or incomparable history never confirms growth. This is not field-normalized growth.
growth_gates: at least two active recent years
unknown: Missing components stay null without renormalizing weights. Metadata author diversity does not establish independent replication.

categories.unassessed_cluster: Not yet a verified specific technology
categories.insufficient_evidence: Unknown novelty, incomplete history, unsupported claims, or unmet emergence conditions
categories.confirmed_trend: Every growth gate and reviewed novelty >= 50; not a claim of earliest weak-signal status or predicted success
categories.early_signal: Reviewed low-volume hypothesis: complete history and earlier search, specific technology, supported claims, novelty >=75, B=0, 2<=R<10, first observed within three years, nondecreasing recent transitions with positive final change
categories.renewed_interest: Growth gates pass, reviewed novelty zero
categories.established_topic: Reviewed novelty zero, growth gates do not pass
categories.transient_burst: Reviewed novel candidate with rise then fall in the last three years
categories.declining: Reviewed novel candidate with nonpositive first transition and falling final year

score_interpretation: Uncalibrated evidence-priority heuristic, not a weak-signal probability. Bounds represent missing contributions, not a statistical confidence interval. Eligibility precedes ranking; publication volume cannot bypass novelty.
validation_status: Regression tested against known failures; independent scientific calibration remains a separate measured acceptance condition.
